relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.role: Luce Foundation Professor in East Asian Studies
relations.evidence: Nicola Di Cosmo (Chinese: 狄宇宙; pinyin: Dí Yǔzhòu;) is the Luce Foundation Professor in East Asian Studies at the Institute for Advanced Study.

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.object: Department of Uralic and Altaic Studies of Indiana University
relations.evidence: Di Cosmo earned a Ph.D. degree from the Department of Uralic and Altaic Studies of Indiana University in 1991.

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.evidence: He was a research fellow at the University of Cambridge from 1989 to 1992

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.evidence: Rockefeller Fellow and lecturer at Indiana University from 1992 to 1993

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.evidence: assistant professor of Harvard University from 1993 to 1997

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.evidence: and taught at the University of Canterbury from 1998 to 2003.

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.evidence: In 2015, he taught as a visiting professor at New York University Shanghai.

relations.subject: Nicola Di Cosmo
relations.evidence: He is currently a faculty member of the Weatherhead East Asian Institute.
